about: The introitus of the formulary “Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars. Sing a new song to the Lord, for He has worked wonders. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
